_doc: Buccaneer skill definitions (spec #412, one region per ticket): B4 #416 moves the five ported knuckle skills (Flash Fist, Somersault Kick, Backspin Blow, Double Uppercut, Corkscrew Blow) here from skills/pirate.json; B5 #417 changes Dash's slot (Dash stays in pirate.json); B6 Energy Drain; B7 Energy Orb; B8 Barrage, Dragon Strike; B9 Transformation, Shockwave; B10 Super Transformation, Demolition, Snatch. Until a key is defined in a file it is inert: never offered or learned. A key may be defined in one file only (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md 4.4.4). B2 #414 defines none.

energy_drain.name: Energy Drain
energy_drain.desc: Spends all your energy to strike one monster in front of you and absorb part of the damage as HP.

text.desc: Needs a full Energy Charge. Spends all your energy on one monster in front of you; the more energy, the harder the blow. You absorb part of the damage as HP, capped at half your MaxHP and the monster's MaxHP.
text.h: Damage {damage}%, absorb {x}% of damage as HP.

energy_drain._provenance: Tier A: Skill.wz 5111004 damage 275 to 360 % and x (the heal percent, 12 to 20 %) at the eight mapped levels, the canonical box lt (-200,-100) rb (0,0), mobCount 1, the edrain action, req Energy Charge, the effect (15 frames) and hit/0 (15 frames) art, the Use and Hit sounds. Tier C (spec #412 BU-4, BU-5, BU-15, B6 #418): a finisher on the Energy Charge meter (min 10, spends all, +12 % damage per energy spent), the cast rule box on one target, a 2.0 s cooldown (the 1.0 s meter floor would hide a Booster), the 0.6 s stance hold, and damage_heal reuses Drain's (7.25) listener with the cap of half MaxHP and the target's MaxHP. Rarity names are the lineage's (Energy Mastery is ours). GAME_DESIGN 7.91.
